messages:
Maya (PM): Quick flag from onboarding: users hit a friction point where the in-console help says 'Pin model' but the docs say 'Pin model version' — caused confusion.

Kevin (Design): Noted. Also the inlay 'Learn more' link lands at doc top. We should deep-link to the exact heading and make CTA more specific.

Sylvia (DevEx): Current helper returns /docs/models. Suggest extending to getDocLink('models', 'pin-model-version') -> /docs/models#pin-model-version so components can request anchors.

Raj (Eng): I can add fragment support and an optional ariaLabel param. Example: getDocLink('models', 'pin-model-version', {ariaLabel: 'Opens pinning docs in a new tab'})

Emma (A11y): Please ensure links open in a new tab with rel="noopener noreferrer" and include an aria-label. Also make the external icon keyboard-focusable and add aria-controls on the close button.

Maya (PM): Agreed decisions: (1) Standardize on 'Pin model version' everywhere. (2) Deep-link using '#pin-model-version'. (3) Open docs in new tab + aria attrs.

Kevin (Design): I'll update the inlay copy to 'See pinning docs' and switch panel headings to sentence case to match docs. Small visual: add 4px spacing between text and external icon.

Sylvia (DevEx): I'll add a short docs style note and a redirect for top-level links. Also adding mapping for inlay ids: inlay-doc-models -> panel id.

Raj (Eng): I'll ship the helper change + unit tests and a tiny e2e that diffs console labels vs docs headings to catch future mismatches. PR: https://git.internal/rdw/pulls/499

DocBot: Linter update: warn when frontend references /docs/* without fragment.

Maya (PM): Action owners: Raj (link helper + e2e), Sylvia (docs id + style guide), Kevin (component copy + spacing), Emma (a11y checklist). Re-open thread if anything else pops up. :white_check_mark:
